title: 词记原创示例：日常学习

cards.definition: To give your attention to one task.
cards.example: I focus on one small goal each morning.
cards.exampleZh: 我每天早晨专注于一个小目标。

supplementary.notes: Use the phrase in a sentence about your own learning.

cloze.prompt: I ____ on one small goal each morning.

cards.definition: To change so that you can work well in a new situation.
cards.example: We adapt our plan after each test.
cards.exampleZh: 每次测试后，我们都会调整计划。

supplementary.notes: Use the phrase in a sentence about your own learning.

cloze.prompt: We ____ our plan after each test.

conversion.prompt: The new schedule required a period of ____.

cards.definition: Wanting to learn or find out more about something.
cards.example: The curious student asked how the machine worked.
cards.exampleZh: 这位好奇的学生询问机器如何运转。

supplementary.notes: Use the phrase in a sentence about your own learning.

cloze.prompt: The ____ student asked how the machine worked.

conversion.prompt: Her ____ led her to read about space.

cards.definition: To watch carefully in order to notice details.
cards.example: We observe the plants and write down any changes.
cards.exampleZh: 我们观察植物，并记录任何变化。

supplementary.notes: Use the phrase in a sentence about your own learning.

cloze.prompt: We ____ the plants and write down any changes.

cards.definition: Continuing at an even level without sudden changes.
cards.example: A steady routine helps me learn every day.
cards.exampleZh: 稳定的日常安排帮助我每天学习。

supplementary.notes: Use the phrase in a sentence about your own learning.

cloze.prompt: A ____ routine helps me learn every day.

cards.definition: To become better or to make something better.
cards.example: Reading aloud can improve my confidence.
cards.exampleZh: 大声朗读能提高我的自信心。

supplementary.notes: Use the phrase in a sentence about your own learning.

conversion.prompt: There was a clear ____ in his writing.
